svg.title: Rural fringe: three regions of eighteen Support
svg.desc: A northern city belt sits above the Centre, with mixed districts to the southwest and a broad rural fringe to the southeast. Shared border segments define adjacency; corners do not. Bellweather Centre borders all three regions.
svg.text: Urban: 18 / 9 votes Mixed: 18 / 9 votes Outlying: 18 / 9 votes Centre: 3 separate Support
Circles = Support spaces. Heavy lines = region borders. Thin lines = district borders.
Concept only · District elections remain local · Territory size does not indicate capacity
